The benefit of spending the afternoon working as a math tutor is $10 (= $45 − $35). The cost of spending the afternoon working as a math tutor is the $8 (= $20 − $12) in economic surplus you would have received by going to the movies. In this case, your economic surplus from going to the movies would be $8 (= $20 − $12) and your economic surplus from working as a math tutor would be $10 (= $45 − $35).
